Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.11 adds an in-game Eleanor portrait selector: Auto keeps this mod's art for native calls and its own story while yielding to another mod's portrait and pausing expressions; Force uses this mod's portrait for every Eleanor; Other uses vanilla/other-mod portraits everywhere, including this mod's story. Native Eleanor takeover is now method-scoped and no longer blocks another mod's own Eleanor events. 1.10 voice pass and 1.07–1.09 entry, hit-area, bracelet and portrait-compatibility fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.11 新增游戏内埃莉诺立绘选择：Auto 原版/本 MOD 剧情用本 MOD 立绘，其他 MOD 覆盖时让位并暂停表情；Force 所有埃莉诺都用本 MOD 立绘；Other 完全使用原版/其他 MOD 立绘，本 MOD 剧情客户也回退原版键。原版接管改为按调度方法作用域，不再误拦其他 MOD 自己的埃莉诺事件。1.10 voice pass 与 1.07–1.09 入线、点击区、手镯与立绘兼容修复保留。简体中文 / English。
